mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wa_group_invite ( tenant_id, group_id, invite_code, origin, health_status, banned, last_checked_at, last_error_code, failure_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{groupId}, #{inviteCode}, 5, 1, 0, #{observedAt}, NULL, 0, #{now}, #{now}, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_id = COALESCE(group_id, VALUES(group_id)), health_status = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(last_checked_at, 0) AND COALESCE(banned, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE health_status END, last_error_code = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(last_checked_at, 0) AND COALESCE(banned, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE last_error_code END, failure_count = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(last_checked_at, 0) AND COALESCE(banned, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE failure_count END, last_checked_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_checked_at, 0), VALUES(last_checked_at)), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))
mapper.select: SELECT profile.health_status AS healthStatus, profile.banned, profile.checked_member_count AS currentCount, profile.last_checked_at AS lastCheckAt, profile.last_error_code AS lastHealthError, profile.failure_count AS healthFailureCount FROM wa_group current_group INNER JOIN wa_group_profile profile ON profile.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND profile.group_id = current_group.id WHERE current_group.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current_group.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND current_group.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wa_group_invite ( tenant_id, group_id, invite_code, label_id, origin, preview_subject, avatar_url, preview_observed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, NULL, #{row.inviteCode}, #{labelId}, 1, LEFT(#{row.waSubject}, 255), LEFT(#{row.avatarUrl}, 1024), #{row.lastPreviewAt}, #{now}, #{now}, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label_id = VALUES(label_id), preview_subject = COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(preview_subject)), ''), preview_subject ), avatar_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(avatar_url)), ''), avatar_url), preview_observed_at = VALUES(preview_observed_at), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
